svg.title: Two-person timeline for Joseph and Sophie, positioned to true time scale
svg.desc: Vertical timeline, Joseph on the left, Sophie on the right, positioned proportionally to actual years elapsed rather than evenly spaced, with a minimum gap only where events cluster in the same year or two. Shared events are horizontal lines joining both lifelines. Hollow markers are uncertain or disputed: Joseph's 1879 birth, Sophie's 1883 and 1893 birth-year entries, Joseph's 1905 arrival, and Sophie's possible 1913 manifest match. Joseph: born 1879, possible 1905 arrival manifest, arrival stated in petition 1911, died 1940 auto accident. Sophie: birth year in citizenship papers 1883, death certificate birth year 1893, arrived US 1912, possible 1913 manifest match, citizenship statement as Pyrch 1933, naturalized as Sophie Pyrce 1938, died 1964 heart condition, 24 years after 1940. Shared: married in Muszyna 1910; Stanley born in Poland 1911; Bernice born in Chicago 1913; Charles born in Chicago 1919; Taddeus born in Chicago 1920; Stella born in Chicago 1923; census household recorded as Puirch 1930.
